intro.h2: Small crew, careful work, clear communication
paragraphs: Memory Lane Designs is a handyman and home remodeling business at 1498 State Hwy K in Bois D'Arc, MO. Customers call us The Handyman by Memory Lane Designs, and most of them know us by name: Josh comes out, looks at the job and sends the quote by email, and Alyssa is part of the team homeowners thank in their reviews.

The jobs vary. One family called us first to hang a ceiling fan and came back to have a shower replaced in a tight space with drywall involved. Another had us cut an arched opening between two rooms. Through all of it, people mention the same things: we show up on time, we cover floors and counters, and we text to keep you posted.

services.h2: What we do around the house

items.name: Shower replacement
items.blurb: Old shower stall worn out? We pull it, deal with the drywall around it and set a new one, even in a tight space. On one job the homeowner said the old shower wasn't pretty, and that they couldn't be happier with the new one.

image.alt: New white shower stall with molded corner shelves, chrome fixtures and a frosted glass door in a mint green bathroom

items.name: Arched openings and wall changes
items.blurb: Want two rooms to feel like one? We cut new openings in existing walls and finish them so they look original. One customer had us add a rounded arch from her living room into the kitchen, and she shared before and after photos.

image.alt: Living room with a new rounded arched opening leading into the kitchen, white walls and wood-look floors

items.name: Accent walls and trim
items.blurb: A grid of trim panels painted one bold color can change how a whole room feels. Our photos show a slate blue wall behind a bed and a deep green board-and-batten wall in a bonus room, both above warm wood-look floors.

image.alt: Deep green board-and-batten accent wall with a tray ceiling and ceiling fan above wood-look plank floors

items.name: Decks and steps
items.blurb: Josh builds decks with railings and stairs. On one deck he used extra techniques to help keep moisture from ruining the boards, which the homeowner said was more than they ever expected. Ask about stain and a baby gate when we plan yours.

image.alt: New pressure-treated wood deck with black balusters and a set of stairs down to the lawn behind a beige house

items.name: Ceiling fans and handyman fixes
items.blurb: Not every job is a remodel. Customers have called us to install a ceiling fan, and the list of small things around a house never really ends. Send us your list and Josh will price it so you know the cost before we schedule a day.

process.h2: How a project with us goes

steps.title: Call or send a message
steps.text: Call (417) 597-3233 on a weekday between 8 AM and 5 PM and tell us what you have in mind.

steps.title: Josh takes a look
steps.text: Josh comes by to see the space, then sends you a written quote by email so you can look it over.

steps.title: Pick the days

If you need any work done around the house, Josh is your guy!

service_area.h2: Handyman and home remodeling in Bois D'Arc, MO
service_area.text: Our address is 1498 State Hwy K in Bois D'Arc, MO, and that is where our work starts. Google does not list a wider service area for us yet, so if you live outside town, the easiest way to find out whether we can help is to call (417) 597-3233 on a weekday. Tell us where you are and what the job is, whether that is a shower, a deck or a ceiling fan.

items.q: What kinds of jobs do you take on?
items.a: Our reviews and photos show shower replacements, an arched opening between two rooms, accent walls with trim panels, decks with stairs and ceiling fan installation. If your project is not on that list, call and describe it. We will tell you honestly whether it is a good fit for us.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Call (417) 597-3233. Josh will come out to see the job and then send you a quote by email, so you have the price in writing before anything is scheduled. Customers who have hired us more than once say the quotes were reasonable both times.

items.q: Will you protect my house while you work?
items.a: Yes. On one shower replacement the crew covered the floors they walked on in the hall and living room, and covered as much as they could on the counters. Keeping your home clean while we work is part of the job, not an extra.

items.q: How will I know what is happening during the job?
items.a: We keep you posted from start to finish. Customers mention that communication was great and that updates came by text. We also agree on the days we will be at your house before work starts, so you can plan around us without guessing.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. You can reach us at (417) 597-3233 during those hours, or email thehandymanbymld@gmail.com with a few photos of the job and a good time to call you back.

final_cta.text: Call Josh and Alyssa to talk it over and get a quote by email.
